description: Use this when you need priced holdings and windowed PnL for one Solana wallet. Holdings valued in USD, a short plain-language summary, windowed realized and unrealized PnL, win rate, and evidence-backed labels such as active memecoin trader. Includes copyTradeScore and copyTradeGrade: copy-return after a 3s delay and a 3.6% round trip, win rate, sample-size shrinkage, and bot or insider penalties. The score is null when no close lasted at least 3 seconds. txLimit is an integer from 5 to 25 and defaults to 20. Call free wallet_preview first if you only need SOL balance and last-active time, or wallet_quick for a cheaper copy-trade screen. Costs $0.009 USDC (9000 base units) via x402. The same price is charged for HTTP GET /wallet/profile. An unpaid HTTP call returns 402 even when the query is missing or invalid. A signed call with invalid arguments is rejected before settlement and is not charged. A successful result can set cached, stale, and cacheAgeMs. stale true means a previous result was served while a refresh runs or the upstream failed. You are charged only when the tool result is not an error.

address.description: Solana wallet address in base58 (32 to 44 characters). Example: HD1ryR3dYSXBVNGfJZydbpmnChiE1wrAQkupWWtHt4pM

txLimit.description: Recent signatures to inspect. Integer from 5 to 25, or a numeric string. Default 20.

name: wallet_profile
